+package main
+
+import (
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+func TestLiveGoldenChildSkipsPristineBootstrap(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	if containsTestArgument(os.Args, "--live-golden-child") {
+		if pristineWorkspaceRoot != "" {
+			t.Fatalf("live golden child initialized unused pristine workspace %q", pristineWorkspaceRoot)
+		}
+		return
+	}
+	cmd := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-test.run=^TestLiveGoldenChildSkipsPristineBootstrap$", "--", "--live-golden-child")
+	output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("live golden child harness: %v; output: %s", err, strings.TrimSpace(string(output)))
+	}
+}

0ff2eee feat(review): record provenanced Human Outcomes with readiness Stops
Add Human Outcome recording bound to active Kit Activation provenance and
the human-outcome.record capability (never a role string or --by human
flag), with the human-outcome Evidence type carrying producer:"human",
trust_source:"activated-human", artifact_availability:"not-applicable",
and strict class/result admission (outcome-not-permitted otherwise). Raise
human-outcome-required atomically from all four DEC-224 producer Events
(envelope.activated, evidence.linked, review.recorded,
artifact.availability-observed) via a shared workflow readiness helper.
Delete the DEC-192 human-outcome.recorded fence key and converge task 7/9
seeded Outcome fixtures onto the real recorded producer.

Fix a class-mismatch admission bug where a same-type, different-outcome_class
Human Outcome link fell through to a generic invalid-argument error instead
of the spec-required outcome-not-permitted denial. Fix
currentReviewBudgetResult to re-derive stops/attention from a
review.recorded Event's own Effects even when no budget_samples row is
present, so a Review that resolves an Obligation's last blocking Finding
with no budget sample involved still raises its readiness Stop.

Refs: phase-23/task-10
